title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Psalms 21: the king rejoicing in Yahweh's strength, his crown of fine gold and the defeat of those who hate Yahweh.

questions.text: In what does the king rejoice in the opening verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 21:1 says the king rejoices in Yahweh's strength and greatly rejoices in his salvation.

questions.text: What has God given the king, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says God has given the king his heart's desire and has not withheld the request of his lips.

questions.text: What does God set on the king's head?
questions.explanation: Psalms 21:3 says God sets a crown of fine gold on his head.

questions.text: What did the king ask of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he asked life of God, and God gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

questions.text: Through what will the king not be moved?
questions.explanation: Psalms 21:7 says the king trusts in Yahweh, and through the loving kindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

answers.text: The loving kindness of the Most High

questions.text: According to verse 8, what will find out those who hate Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says Yahweh's hand will find out all his enemies and his right hand will find out those who hate him.

questions.text: What will Yahweh make his enemies like in the time of his anger?
questions.explanation: Psalms 21:9 says he will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of his anger.

questions.text: What will God destroy from the earth, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says God will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

questions.text: What will God aim at the faces of his enemies?
questions.explanation: Psalms 21:12 says God will make them turn their back when he aims drawn bows at their face.

questions.text: In the closing verse, what will 'we' do when Yahweh is exalted in his strength?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says, 'Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.'
